A large kennel has a gate for dogs to enter and a gate for dogs to exit. The kennel can be filled with dogs who use the entrance in 5 hours. The exit gate can be used to empty the kennel in 15 hours. If it is desired that the kennel should be filled, from empty, exactly 6 hours after the entrance gate is opened at 9:30am, then at what time should the exit gate be opened ?

A
10:00am
B
10:45am
C
12:00pm
D
12:30pm
✓ Correct
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option D)

In 6 hours the entrance gate can accept the amount of dogs equal to 6*1/5 = 6/5 of the kennel. So, 1/5 more than necessary, which should be compensated by the exit gate. To ride the kennel 1/5 of the dogs the exit gate needs 15/5 = 3 hours. Therefore, the exit gate should be opened at 9:30am + 6 hours - 3 hours = 12:30pm. Answer: D.

B
401
C

✓ Correct
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option D)

A positive integer can give only the following 9 remainders when divided by 9: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 0. 1 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 1; 2 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 2; ... 8 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 8; 9 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 0. We'll have 11 such blocks, since 99/9=11. The last will be: 91 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 1; 92 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 2; ... 98 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 8; 99 divided by 9 gives the remainder of 0. The last number, 100, gives the remainder of 1 when divided by 9, thus the sum of all remainders will be: 11(1+2+3+4+5+6+7+8+0)+1=364. Answer: E.
